hints.title: Tokenize Sentence
hints.text: Split the sentence into whitespace-separated tokens.

hints.title: Digit Token Identification
hints.text: Filter for tokens that consist entirely of digits to extract numeric values.

hints.title: Strict Order Verification
hints.text: Check whether every numeric value is strictly greater than the preceding one.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Extracts numeric tokens and checks strict monotonicity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing full string with complex regex is prone to delimiter edge cases.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simple whitespace splitting gives minimal overhead and clear logic.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should correctly distinguish numeric tokens from alphanumeric words.
